texts: mixed: the group of Keepers, the "a few" count and each Keeper's own notebook all come through, but the notebook's two contents were packed into a single listing record holding both objects at once instead of one record per content, which is not the shape the translator is supposed to produce for a coordinated object. Repeat the verb so each content gets its own clause: "A few Keepers each keep a notebook that lists moth-counts and that lists weather notes." Separately, a capitalised plural label under a count ("A few Keepers") sits on a boundary our instruction set has not yet settled; writing it lowercase, "a few keepers", removes any risk of it being read as a proper name instead of as members of the keeper class.
